title: Stand XT-10 Live Broadcast Selfie Stick Tripod Black NEW
categoryName: Cell Phones & Accessories:Cell Phone Accessories:Mounts & Holders
descriptionText: The Stand XT-10 Live Broadcast Selfie Stick Tripod in black is a versatile accessory for live broadcasting and taking selfies. With the capability to be mounted on a desktop, desk, or handlebar, this tripod provides stability and ease of use for capturing a steady shot. The Stand brand ensures quality and reliability for your live broadcasting needs.
